title: Applications are invited for In-Person Brainstorming Session on "AI-Powered Pharmacopoeia Standards Development & Pharmacovigilance Practices.”
bodyHtml:
The details of the session are as follows:

The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) invites professionals, researchers, academicians, regulators, and industry experts to participate in a one-day brainstorming session focused on exploring the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence in healthcare, pharmaceutical standards, and pharmacovigilance.
The session will bring together experts from the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory authorities, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), academic institutions, and IT professionals to discuss innovative AI-driven solutions for enhancing quality, safety, and regulatory excellence.

Date: 20th August, 2026 (Thursday)
Registration Fee: Rs. 1,000/-+ GST 18%
Mode: physical (offline) mode
Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSerm0TKYJ5wv-HG6R5qnPFtgVHbB0ooW8NIuT6-6XFdpYI_vQ/viewform
(opens in a new tab)Registration Deadline: Registrations ended.
Venue: Dr. Nitya Anand Auditorium, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ghaziabad.
